_comment: Copy to ~/.config/standup-ghost/config.json (or let /standup-ghost:setup write it). Everything user-specific lives HERE, never in the repo.

identity._note: Setup DISCOVERS these from your connected tools (gh api user / atlassianUserInfo / slack_search_users) — you confirm, you don't type IDs.
identity._handle_note: Appears in the standup heading and is the per-person idempotency key on shared canvases. Defaults to your Slack display name.
identity._slack_user_id_note: Used only for review-mode self-DM drafts.

schedule._note: Local time. Changing this and re-running setup (or doctor) regenerates the launchd jobs.

jira.jql_recent: assignee = currentUser() AND updated >= "-{lookback_hours}h" ORDER BY updated DESC
jira.jql_in_progress: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory = "In Progress" ORDER BY priority ASC, updated DESC
jira._include_sprint_note: OFF by default. When true (or asked on demand), bucket lines carry the active sprint name.

gcal._exclude_note: Substring match, case-insensitive. Add your daily ceremonies here so they don't clutter the (Calls: …) line.

flavors._note: Per-connector transport choice, written by /standup-ghost:setup after probing what exists on this machine (and asking you when more than one works). atlassian: local|claudeai. github: cli (gh) | mcp (GitHub MCP server). slack: claudeai (interactive connector — DARK in headless/cron) | token (Slack Web API bot token in secrets.json — the headless-capable choice for scheduled posts).

absence._note: Skip the run on non-working days and stretch the next run's lookback to the last working day. Weekends are already non-working via schedule.days; the rest comes from your calendar.
absence._event_types_note: Google Calendar native event types treated as absence (OUT_OF_OFFICE covers the built-in out-of-office block).
absence._event_patterns_note: Case-insensitive substring match on ALL-DAY / full-window event titles — catches leave/sick/holiday events that aren't typed OUT_OF_OFFICE.
absence._holiday_note: Extra calendar IDs to check for all-day events (e.g. your company-holidays calendar). Any all-day event there = non-working day.
